message: Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: actions/upload-artifact@v4. For more information see: https://github.blog/changelog/2025-09-19-deprecation-of-node-20-on-github-actions-runners/

`permissions: id-token: write` is not granted to this job. Aspect features that use the GHA artifact API (e.g. ArtifactUpload) will be disabled. To enable, add:

  permissions:
    id-token: write

to your workflow or job. See https://docs.aspect.build/cli/authentication for details.
